summary: Backend + frontend smoke/integration tests for Araújo Deluxe. 14/14 pytest tests pass (services, business-hours, availability, booking + double-book 409, admin auth by password, admin protected endpoints). Frontend HashRouter loads landing correctly; /#/admin login page renders with data-testid; wrong password shows 'Senha incorreta' toast; correct password '1234' logs in and redirects to /#/admin/dashboard with token stored in localStorage ('ad_token'). Dashboard shows stats and daily agenda with correct slots.

minor.issue: Backend startup tries to auto-spawn WhatsApp bot via subprocess with cwd=/app/whatsapp-bot; when that path doesn't exist it logs a warning (non-fatal). Consider gating behind an env flag.

Brute-force lockout keyed on client IP + admin identifier. In a proxied/preview env (single ingress IP) 5 failed attempts across users would lock the whole IP for 15 minutes; not tested here to avoid locking the environment.

issues: Uses browser default <input type='date'> picker instead of a shadcn Calendar component - inconsistent with the rest of the styled UI.

action_items: (Optional) Replace native date input on admin dashboard with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for visual consistency.
(Optional) Guard the WhatsApp bot subprocess spawn in server.py startup behind an env flag (e.g. ENABLE_WA_BOT) since bot is currently disabled placeholder.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 852 lines and mixes auth, bookings, admin, WhatsApp bot, PIX helpers and conversation engine. Should be split into modules (auth.py, bookings.py, admin.py, whatsapp.py, pix.py).
Lockout uses client IP which is unreliable behind reverse proxy; consider X-Forwarded-For handling or account-based lockout.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection everywhere returned to clients - good.
Env vars accessed with os.environ[...] (fail-fast) - good; matches guideline of no default fallbacks.
get_current_user works with both cookie and Bearer header - good.
test_credentials: Admin password: 1234 (from ADMIN_PASSWORD env). No /app/memory/test_credentials.md file present.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_ booking during double-booking test (on a future available slot, service designer-simples, client TEST_Cliente / 11987654321). Left in DB (booking status 'pendente').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Admin login is password-only (POST /api/auth/login {password:'1234'}). Frontend uses HashRouter so admin URL is FRONTEND_URL/#/admin. data-testids present: admin-login-password, admin-login-submit. Brute-force lockout by IP - do not intentionally trigger it or admin will be locked 15 min.
rca of the issue: N/A - no failing issue. All targeted flows (catalog, availability, booking creation + 409 double-book, admin password login, protected endpoints, frontend admin login redirect) are working.
